title: Pure-Rust experimental capability matrix (honest SSOT)

legend.FULL: Production-usable semantic parity with TS 3.0.14 intent for this slice

claimedForDifferential: exact 14-case immutable TS v3.0.14 behavior subset: full text, page selection/order/duplicates, metadata, literal search, case sensitivity, whole word, Unicode, UTF-16 offsets, uniformly estimated selectable-text match bounding boxes and levels, missing and malformed inputs, mixed-source partial success, inherited crop/media/rotation geometry with page UserUnit, an indirect Link/URI annotation, common catalog signals, a bounded AcroForm text/parent-widget/checkbox/listbox subset, and EmbeddedFiles metadata with distinct ASCII tree keys, path-normalized filenames, descriptions, fixture ordering, and unfiltered content sizes

exact 16-case immutable TS v3.0.14 render/crop/command-provider semantic subset over stdio: defaults, page selection and warnings, region ordering, padding and fractional bounds, rotated pages, mixed-source and late-provider partial success, all-source failure, MCP image indexing, standalone OCR normalization, read_pdf OCR text-layer/map fusion, boxed OCR table projection into elements/chunks/markdown/html/document_ast/document_map, rich region-analysis normalization, plain-text truncation, and truthful provenance; exact pdf.js pixels and antialiasing are not claimed

exact 11-case immutable TS v3.0.14 tagged-structure and inspect subset: RoleMap, ParentTree, StructParents, inherited page association, scalar-reference, scalar-direct, combined-scalar, and array StructTreeRoot/StructElem /K plus ParentTree values, MCID/MCR and OBJR identifiers, sorted/deduplicated selected pages, empty Root pages, untagged omission, accessibility-private consumption, document-map accessibility routing, auto-full explicit-false override, and tagged-fixture inspect profile/page/document/recommendation signals; fixture, runner, projection, normalizer, generator, TS source, and pdf.js 6.0.227 digests are bound with mutation-sensitivity checks

exact 1-case immutable TS v3.0.14 selectable-text geometry subset: ordered text-layer pages, lines, runs, words, and characters; JavaScript UTF-16 offsets; line/run/word/character boxes and coverage summaries; text-element boxes; and ordered citation-chunk box propagation; baseline tag/tree/lock, TS source, runner, corpus, fixture, and oracle digests are bound with canonical mutation rejection

exact 6-case immutable TS v3.0.14 citation-chunk subset: chunks-only hidden element construction, chunks-plus-elements exposure, semantic-boundary enablement, document-map-only internal semantic chunks, plain top-level chunk reuse by document_map, global chunk ordinals, page/semantic/size boundary precedence, newline joining, exact element IDs and boxes, and JavaScript UTF-16 size accounting; baseline tag/tree/lock, TS source, runner, corpus, generated fixture, and oracle digests are bound with canonical chunk-ID mutation rejection

exact 3-case immutable TS v3.0.14 semantic-hint subset: semantic-hint omission when disabled; complete role, confidence, ordered signals, and optional level objects for caption, header, footer, named/numbered/roman/large-text headings, list items, and default paragraphs; and exact heading-driven citation-chunk propagation over the frozen fixtures; baseline tag/commit/tree/lock, documentModel, semanticPatterns, readCoordinator, content types, runner, corpus, generator, fixture manifest, fixture, and oracle digests are bound with role/confidence/signals/level mutation rejection

exact 6-case immutable TS v3.0.14 text-only document-AST subset: AST-only hidden semantic-element and chunk dependencies, reuse of already-exposed plain chunks, reuse of exposed semantic elements/chunks, sorted/deduplicated selected pages, exact node IDs/types/tree hierarchy/heading levels, cross-page section_path and continued_from_section_id, present bounding boxes, aggregate element_ids/chunk_ids/page ranges, complete text-only summaries/max_depth, exact top-level and AST warning propagation with a retained heading, and the no-heading warning; baseline tag/commit/tree/lock, documentAst/readCoordinator/documentModel/semanticPatterns/types, runner/projection/corpus/generator/fixture manifest/fixture/oracle digests are bound with raw type-strict allowlists, dependency-leak checks, omission probes, and an exact mutation manifest

exact 8-case immutable TS v3.0.14 text-first document-map subset: map-only hidden semantic-element/chunk/text-layer/layout/safety/geometry dependencies, within-runtime cache identity for exposed plain chunks, semantic elements/chunks, layout, safety, geometry, and ordinary text-layer counters, exact version/profile/layer ordering, page envelopes, element/chunk indexes, ordinary line/word/character and bounding-box coverage counters, layout diagnostics, prompt-injection safety finding/index/warning routing, sorted/deduplicated pages [3,1,3], empty-page low-confidence/needs-OCR routing, aggregate summaries, and a 10,001-page public range admission bounded to actual document pages; baseline tag/commit/tree/lock, documentMap/readCoordinator/documentModel/semanticPatterns/textLayer/extractor/types, runner/projection/corpus/generator/fixture manifest/fixture/oracle digests are bound with raw type-strict allowlists, dependency/private-surface checks, omission probes, exact candidate SHA binding, and an exact mutation manifest; include_document_map remains PARTIAL

DNS-pinned URL fetch: one resolution per redirect hop, reject mixed public/non-public answers, disable ambient proxies, and revalidate every redirect; still PARTIAL because resolver timeout and TLS-SNI fixtures remain open

explicitlyNotClaimed: complete TS 3.0.14 semantic parity outside the immutable 14-case subset

read_pdf text-layer/element/chunk geometry outside the frozen selectable-text subset, glyph-perfect pdf.js boxes, text-layer font/direction/transform/EOL metadata, citation-chunk semantics outside the frozen 6-case schema/boundary/dependency subset, semantic-hint classification outside the frozen 3-case classifier/chunk-propagation subset including unrepresented layout variants, raw page_contents payload/presence parity, document-AST semantics outside the frozen 6-case text-only hierarchy/cache/warning subset including captions/caption links, tables, images, visual enrichments, OCR fusion, and broader semantic/layout variants, document-map semantics outside the frozen 8-case text-first envelope/cache/routing subset including OCR, trust, accessibility, tables, images, visual enrichments, provider fusion, and arbitrary hostile internal chunk spans, selectable-table detection, search geometry outside the frozen selectable-text subset, direct-annotation PDF.js presentation normalization, non-Link annotation/action parity, and general bounding-box parity

within the frozen document-map subset, exact cross-runtime provenance label values are not claimed because Rust truthfully reports pdf-reader-core/selectable-text instead of pdfjs/text-content; PDF.js-only empty text runs and run/font/direction/transform/EOL-dependent text-layer counts are schema-validated but excluded from semantic value comparison
render/crop/OCR/analyze/read-fusion/table-projection semantic parity outside the immutable 16-case subset, including exact pdf.js pixels and antialiasing
OCR success paths outside the opt-in command JSON/plain-text subset, including tesseract-tsv; mixed selectable/OCR table continuation; analyze_regions HTTP and preset providers

full COS outline/PageLabels/permissions parity outside the frozen common catalog subset; AcroForm radio/pushbutton/signature, button-array V coercion, and malformed-field breadth, integer-like/duplicate attachment-key ordering, odd-length Names arrays (PDF.js may materialize a final unnamed entry), filtered embedded-stream decoded sizes, and Associated Files
